mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (user_id, message, contact, page, client) VALUES (#{userId}, #{message}, #{contact}, #{page}, #{client})
mapper.sql: SELECT f.*, u.nickname, u.email FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = f.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback f f.is_done = #{done}
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET is_done = #{done} WHERE id = #{id}
